Have those issues been requiring several repairs? If so, Joseph A. Kaufman & Associates can help you file a lemon law claim to solve your problems. TOP CADILLAC LYRIQ ISSUES The Cadillac Lyriq is an electric crossover with a starting price around $58,000. Despite its much-hyped recent launch, it has already been suffering from serious flaws and recalls. Common Cadillac Lyriq issues include: Cracking liftgate panel. Faulty battery packs causing loss of power. infotainment screen malfunction. The good news is that if your Cadillac Lyriq SUV is still under manufacturer’s warranty and these or any other issues have not been handled in a reasonable number of repair attempts, you might be protected by consumer protection laws and California’s lemon law. California’s lemon law is designed to protect the consumer rights of those who have bought, leased or serviced their vehicles in California, or active duty military with a connection to California. It requires car companies such as General Motors to repurchase or replace any defective vehicle that suffer from warranty defects that cannot be fixed in a reasonable number of attempts – usually as low as 2 repair attempts. So if you bought in California a 2023 or newer Cadillac Lyriq that’s a lemon, you are entitled to get monetary compensation, a lemon law buyback or replacement vehicle. Best of all, it won’t cost you anything as all attorney fees and costs will be paid by the GM. Catherine S – Alhambra, CA.      “Joe is amazing to work with and really helped me get back after GM kept giving me the run around” Christopher R – CA FAQ What qualifies as Lemon Law in California? A vehicle qualifies for California’s Lemon Law if it has been purchased or leased in California, is less than 6 years old and suffers from warranty defects that cannot be fixed in a reasonable number of attempts – usually as low as 2 warranty repair attempts. How Long Does The Lemon Law Take? Car companies are supposed to repurchase or replace lemon vehicles promptly, but they rarely do. While occasionally a lemon law claim may be resolved in 30 days, it is more likely that a lemon law claim may take 3 to 6 months to be fully resolved. How does the Cadillac Lyric Buyback program work? The Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act, aka California’s lemon law, entitles consumers to refund or replacement if a new vehicle under warranty has substantial defects that the manufacturer or dealer cannot fix after a reasonable number of attempts. The refund includes down payment, monthly payments, most recent registration expense and paying off a loan, if any. It also allows recovery of attorney fees and penalties against manufacturers. How much will I get from the lemon lawsuit? How much you get from your Cadillac class action settlement depends on your vehicle issues, mileage, price and claim. Lemon law payouts usually range from $10,000 to $25,000 for economy cars and $35,000 to over $75,000 for luxury vehicles. How Much Does A Lemon Law Lawyer Cost? It won’t cost you anything as all fees & costs are covered by the manufacturer.
